strings.pdf.title: PDF Utility
strings.pdf.empty_merge_desc: Add two or more PDFs to preview pages in order and combine them into one file.
strings.pdf.empty_split_desc: Select a PDF document to preview all pages, split into chunks, or click pages to extract.
strings.pdf.empty_images_desc: Add PNG, JPEG, WebP, or BMP images to preview and arrange them into a PDF.
strings.pdf.empty_office_desc: Add Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or OpenDocument files to convert locally via LibreOffice.
strings.pdf.pdfium_missing_desc: Open App Settings -> PDFium WebAssembly (pdfium.wasm), click Download pdfium.wasm or select pdfium.wasm, then click Reload Preview.
strings.pdf.pdfium_invalid_title: PDFium preview engine failed to load
strings.pdf.page_range: Page Selection (click pages or type e.g. 1-3, 5)
strings.pdf.libreoffice_missing: LibreOffice (soffice) not found. Configure its path in Settings.
strings.pdf.office_preview_hint: Office documents are rendered by LibreOffice during conversion. Click Convert Documents to generate and preview the PDF.
